description: Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. PR3 (fz-kdt.48). Re-cut 2026-09-16 after building and measuring the original 'One Ty per callable value' at the intern boundary (see the comment): landed as the fold of specialize_lit_arrow (construction) and specialize_callable_clause (read) into one sigs::specialize_surface, plus the callable-axis exclusion from the one absorber restated in types/axis.rs as THREE proven facts with tests: (1) a lit-free arrow is the activation key's record carrier and a resolved spec's decomposition, which the kernel calls the whole axis, so saturation would erase what arrow_params/arrow_result read back (arrow_result's callers expect it: a panic); (2) a lit-bearing arrow's params/result are planner evidence added back by row_column_dominates (free-var ids equal, lit_arrow_shapes containment, is_subtype); (3) the kernel endorses closure[f]([mailbox]) <= closure[f]([any]), so absorbing the pair would be exact and would erase the narrower environment callable_clauses hands to transport (pinned by transport_relation_incremental_test::a_nested_source_union_retains_both_environments_of_the_same_function). A first cut wrongly retracted (3); the cold review caught it. Census unchanged 128 / 15. The identity half ('one Ty per callable value') is NOT achievable at Types::intern: Ty on the callable axis carries denotation and planner evidence at once; it moves to fz-kdt.48.11, which blocks fz-kdt.48.8.

comments.text: Measured 2026-09-16 on 90b86e0a9. Duplicate pairs by class (enum_take_drop_split / range_map_converges / json_roundtrip): one closure literal stored at several surfaces (construction vars, addressed vars, ground instance) 118 / 11 / 0; lit-free arrows the kernel already calls the whole axis (declared surfaces with an any result) 5 / 4 / 25; tuple carvings 5 / 0 / 2. Three designs built and measured: (A) surface is evidence, dropped from Ty: census 128->14, 15->4 but lib 2161/25 fail incl. activation_input_rows_keep_arrows_that_differ_only_where_subtyping_is_blind (the planner keys specializations by surface); (B') literal + surface as distinct factors, specialize on read (the original ticket text): 128->47, 15->6, 15 fail, and instantiate still writes the surface onto the literal so it lives in two places = a mechanism, rejected; (C) kernel reads the surface as identity: census test fails immediately (shared canonical form, not mutually subtype), canon must render the surface, kernel semantics change. Conclusion: Ty on the callable axis is doing denotation AND evidence; the cure is a carrier of the key's own.

title: One callable surface specialization, and the callable-axis exclusion as proven facts
